description: PHASE 1 Foundation: Evidence logging infrastructure and architectural boundary verification. Creates .project-ai/ directory structure, implements EvidenceRecord Python model, creates evidence logger with run directory management, gate/agent result logging, and snapshot copying. Waves R1 (already complete), R8 (evidence logging), R2 (already complete) executed sequentially per approved design.
steps: 1. Create EvidenceRecord dataclass in services/project-ai/app/models/evidence.py with from_snapshot() classmethod following TypeScript Evidence interface exactly (evidenceId, scannerName, timestamp, path, kind, claim, locator, contentHash, lifecycle, optional symbol and metadata fields)
2. Create .project-ai/runs/ directory structure in repository root for evidence storage

3. Create EvidenceLogger class in services/project-ai/app/evidence/logger.py with create_run_directory() method that: creates {commit-sha}-{snapshot-hash} directory, creates gates/, agents/, screenshots/ subdirectories, copies TypeScript snapshot.json to run directory, writes metadata.json with runId/commitSha/snapshotHash/branch/timestamp/status, updates current symlink (with Windows fallback to current.txt)

4. Add log_gate_result() method to EvidenceLogger that writes gate execution results to .project-ai/runs/{id}/gates/{gate-name}.json with status/timestamp/message/evidenceIds/blockers fields using 2-space JSON indentation

5. Add log_agent_result() method to EvidenceLogger that writes agent execution results to .project-ai/runs/{id}/agents/{agent-id}.json with status/timestamp/executionTimeMs/outputs/evidenceIds/errors/warnings fields using 2-space JSON indentation
6. Add _get_current_branch() helper to EvidenceLogger using subprocess.run(['git', 'branch', '--show-current'])

7. Create tests/evidence/test_logger.py with tests for: run directory creation, metadata generation, snapshot copy to run directory, gate result logging, agent result logging, current symlink update, Windows fallback to current.txt when symlink fails
8. Run pytest tests/evidence/test_logger.py to verify all evidence logging tests pass
acceptance_criteria: services/project-ai/app/models/evidence.py exists with EvidenceRecord dataclass matching TypeScript Evidence interface
services/project-ai/app/evidence/logger.py exists with EvidenceLogger class containing create_run_directory(), log_gate_result(), log_agent_result() methods
tests/evidence/test_logger.py exists with 7+ tests covering all evidence logging functionality
All pytest tests in tests/evidence/test_logger.py pass (100% pass rate)
Evidence logger correctly handles Windows environment (symlink fallback to current.txt)
All JSON files written with 2-space indentation (indent=2 parameter verified in code)
verification: Verify EvidenceRecord model exists: grep -n 'class EvidenceRecord' services/project-ai/app/models/evidence.py
Verify all JSON writes use indent=2: grep -n 'json.dumps.*indent=2' services/project-ai/app/evidence/logger.py
